scenario.description: A tab attaches with a cursor the server can't serve (§3.3) — first load, boot mismatch, or retention-exceeded. It gets a session_snapshot (wipes history), session_state, unsequenced replay of the completed prior turn, an unsequenced projection token for the in-flight answer, catch_up_complete{mode: snapshot}, then the live continuation and done.
scenario.note: The projection token's `replace:true` semantics (§4.4 — a snapshot MUST replace, not append, when the bubble already holds content from a prior run) are NOT implemented by this lane in this pass (flagged gap, SQUAD-REPORT-BEC.md) — this fixture only exercises the case where the bubble starts empty, where append and replace are observably identical, so it does not (and must not be read to) prove replace:true correctness.

expected.secondAssistantMessageContent: partial answer so far... plus the live rest
